patch.description:

**Notes:** Sends a best-effort VENDOR_REVIEW_REJECTED push. Wrapped in withAuditLog (VENDOR).

_Source: `app/api/review-refunds/[id]/reject/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

patch.summary: Revoke an accepted review and reverse the refund
patch.description:
Fraud safety path: revokes an already-accepted review proof and, in one transaction, debits the previously credited points back from the vendor's wallet with a matching Debited ledger entry.

**Notes:** Mutates money: debits the vendor wallet. Sends a best-effort VENDOR_REVIEW_REVOKED push. Wrapped in withAuditLog (VENDOR).

_Source: `app/api/review-refunds/[id]/revoke/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.message: Only an accepted review can be revoked (current: Pending)

post.summary: Approve or reject a vendor credit purchase
post.description:
Approves or rejects a vendorPayments record. On approval it records the admin-verified deposit amount, issues credits (amount/1.18 then /10, floored), writes credit operation logs, mints a GST tax invoice and pushes a Firebase notification to the vendor.

**Notes:** MUTATES MONEY. Credits = floor((verifiedAmount / 1.18) / 10), i.e. the amount is treated as GST-inclusive at 18%. All error paths return HTTP 200 with success:false, including PAID_AMOUNT_REQUIRED and PAID_AMOUNT_INVALID errorCodes - clients must check the body. Side effects on approval: increments vendor creditsAvailable, writes creditOperationLogs and vendorCreditOperation rows, generates and freezes a GST tax invoice PDF to S3 and emails it to the vendor via ensureVendorInvoice (skipped for isInternal vendors so the external invoice series stays gapless), sends a VENDOR_PAYMENT_APPROVED Firebase push, and logs an APPROVE/REJECT admin activity. Notification and invoice failures are swallowed and do not fail the approval. The response returns emailData/fcmData for the caller to act on.

_Source: `app/api/updatevendorpayment/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: reads getServerSession only to name the approver in logs - the approval itself is not gated, so not gated by the handler itself`_

post.summary: Upload and compress an expense invoice image
post.description:
Accepts a multipart image, compresses it with sharp (max width 1920, JPEG quality 80) and uploads it to Linode object storage under Expenses/YYYY/MM. Returns the file URL.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Send as multipart/form-data. Always re-encoded to JPEG regardless of input format, so the returned URL ends in .jpg. Stored on Linode Object Storage (not S3) in a month-partitioned Expenses folder; audit-logged as FINANCE/CREATE.

_Source: `app/api/upload-invoice/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

reason.description: Why the refund is being reversed; blank or missing 400s

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

reason.description: Why the proof was rejected; blank or missing 400s

file.description: Invoice image. MIME type must start with image/. No explicit size cap in this route.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

id.description: vendorPayments paymentId; accepted as string or number

vendorid.description: Vendor id; must match the payment record or the request is refused

action.description: 'approve' issues credits; anything else is treated as a rejection

transactionId.description: Bank/UPI transaction reference; stored only on approval

paidAmount.description: REQUIRED when action is 'approve': the admin-verified amount actually deposited. Must be a positive number. If it differs from the applied amount by more than 1 rupee, the verified figure overwrites the payment amount and drives the credit calculation.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
